D1.title: Owner-only merges of the reviewed draft stacks
D1.lead: Waiting for Owner: TopoFix #13 → #14 → #15; separately #13 → #16 → #17. XML_Compare_Utilities #240 → #241, plus #242. Common #584/#585. Oracle must recheck exact heads, CI and dependencies first. These merges do not confer engineering acceptance.

options.label: Owner merges in reviewed order (suggested)
options.body: Preserve dependency order; require Oracle exact-head and CI verification before each merge.
options.reply: Owner will merge the reviewed draft stacks in order; maintain every engineering HOLD.

options.label: Keep all drafts open
options.body: Choose this if further original-file trials or independent checks are required.
